title: Jon S NDE 6315
content: I was 7 years old and in the second grade. It was the fall, and a windstorm had blown down trees in my yard. My best friend and I were building a fort out of a fallen tree, and we were gathering branches to use for the roof of the fort. I went across the street in front of my house to pick up some branches. I grabbed a branch, looked both ways before starting across the street, took three steps into the road, and on the fourth step, I found myself standing in my bedroom. It seemed perfectly normal for me to be there. The room was lit with a soothing bright white light. I felt totally comfortable and natural. There was a man in a white robe with a white beard and long white hair standing in front of the bay windows of my room. He was looking at me and smiling. I could tell he wanted me to look out the window. I came near the windows and looked out. Down in the road there were several people gathered around in a group. The moment I saw this, everything went black. I heard a voice in the distance saying, 'Can you feel this? Can you feel this?' I started to see blurry forms around me and a squeezing sensation on my foot. I turned my head to the side and felt a hard, cold surface. There was blood in my mouth, and I was choking on it. At that moment, I thought, 'Oh my god, this must be a nightmare! This can't be real because I was just standing in my bedroom! I need to wake up now!!' I strained and strained my eyes wider and wider to wake myself up. The whole time telling myself, 'Wake up now! Wake up now!' I thought for sure that I was dreaming because I could not understand how I got from the safety of my bedroom to here, lying in the street covered in blood. I remember asking if this was real. And someone said, 'You have been hit by a car, Jon. We are taking you to the hospital. You are going to be okay.' I spent 5 days in the hospital. I had 10 stitches in my chin and 24 stitches in my tongue; I knocked out my front left tooth, and the front right tooth got pushed up into my gums. I had oral surgery. I had a massive bruise on my right hip where the car initially hit me, but no broken bones or major internal injury.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Found himself suddenly standing in his bedroom while his body was in the street after being hit by a car; then looked out his bedroom window down to the road where people were gathered.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A man in a white robe with a white beard and long white hair, smiling and directing him to look out the window.

environment.environment_other_detail: Bedroom with bay windows; 'soothing bright white light.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit by a car while crossing the street.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Sudden shift to bedroom; robed man gestured to look out window; then blackness and return to bodily awareness with blood/choking and hearing people speak.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like shift to bedroom occurred immediately without tunnel; brief encounter with robed figure and bright light; then blackness and return to body in street.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transition was to his own bedroom (familiar setting) rather than an otherworldly realm; then it went black before he became aware of being in the street.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Can you feel this? Can you feel this?' / 'You have been hit by a car, Jon. We are taking you to the hospital. You are going to be okay.' / 'Oh my god, this must be a nightmare!'
